title: Fats's mocking vocals and walking out of sessions until the managers calmed him
summary: Fats ad-libbed commentary on bad songs, left the piano, and had to be talked back by managers like Kirkeby, who could not refund the publishers' money.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Was Fats doing his mocking style of singing before he was given all these lousy tunes, or --
-- was it the lousy tunes that brought it on?
That helped. He'd say oh, mercy. am I doing What, what have I done? what have I done? Help me, send somebody. Some ways of different singing he brought out, and oh, oh --
But he was singing like that before he got the dog tunes.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And he jumped in the

middle of the piano, and stop, go take a drink, go to the john, somewhere, anywhere, come back, you know. And -- you just couldn't help it. I mean you'd say what am I doing? I mean why? He'd say forget it, take it out. I don't need it. And then they'd have to talk him back into the idea of staying there, because as I told you, the business office of the publishers, and the recording studios, have gotten together, and they made an idea. They sold talent, time, and whatnot, and they weren't going -- they weren't going to give that money back.
Did Fats ever succeed in not doing something that he was asked to do?

I don't think so. I really don't, and now that you mention it, I've heard him say it a few times, and they would -- now Tom! Now, Tom! And he's raving. Now, Tom! I -- so and so. Don't Tom me. Blah, blah, blah. Here you come with love@ I (Unintelligible), and he'd be screaming and walking up and down the room, and they'd be trying to quieten him down. Now Tom. Tom. Just a minute.
What were the rest of you fellows doing while all this was going on?
Sitting quietly, damned quiet, I'd say, you're right Fats. We don't blame you, you know. Maybe

Yeah, because you don't dare say too much. Who asked you? He may say, but maybe, I mean that's the feeling you would get, but that mean you don't want to put your two cents in too, I mean you can tell, I mean you know better, you know?
